Supply in: Boiler B6 30 mA RCBO
Stage 2 · Evohome (2018 to now): terminal-level wiring as surveyed 29 Oct 2026
Every connection traced at the box with the plant isolated. 6-way positions as surveyed (numbered from the left).
cyl R stat out → R valve
cyl L stat out → L valve
TF and MF valve heads are electrically disconnected (confirmed: their cores are not in the box); their manual-override paddles hold the valves open. The radiator relay feeds the SL joint directly.
The timer output feeds terminal A of both hot-water relays, so the TS715Si still gates hot water. Cylinder cut-outs are in series with the valve motors (verified).
